description: Use this when someone asks which data breaches happened recently or what the latest breaches are. Returns the newest breaches in LeakData's public catalog, newest incident date first, with date, affected account count, exposed data types and first steps. No sign-in is needed. It has no date filter: check the returned dates and say so when none fall in the period the user asked about. It is LeakData's catalog, not every breach worldwide. Not for general security, ransomware or vulnerability news.
name: leakdata.recent_breaches

affectedCountIsMinimum.description: affectedAccounts is a reviewed lower bound, not an exact count.

emailCheckAvailable.description: LeakData holds this breach's records, so an email check can find an address in it.

match.description: similar: only the start of the name matched the query, so it may be a different company.

passwordDataTypeCount.description: How many of the first dataTypes are password-type data.

service.description: The site or company to act on; empty for a combined list or malware log.

title: Latest data breaches
